body: Did you miss HTML Day last week? Ryan McGovern, Chazona Baum, and Austin Galyon hosted the first-ever HTML Day at ECPI Virginia Beach, and more than 40 people of all ages spent the afternoon building websites the old-fashioned way — by hand, with nothing but HTML.
By the time the room packed up, we had launched over a dozen live sites on Neocities. No frameworks, no build step, no install — just a text editor and the markup the web is actually made of.
Breakfast came courtesy of Val Town and lunch from RevolutionVA. Thank you both for keeping the room fed.

photos.alt: A full classroom at ECPI Virginia Beach during HTML Day, dozens of people working at laptops with a 'A dab of CSS' slide on the screen at the front of the room
